propositions: compact.py (793 LOC) bundles three distinct responsibilities (transaction, snapshot reconstruction, CLI) with high cyclomatic complexity and must be decomposed into focused modules
snapshot reconstruction logic and its counter (_REBUILD_COUNT, rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log) must relocate together to compact_rebuild.py to maintain counter coherence
compaction transaction logic (_compact_locked, _sync_before_compact, _maybe_pause_at_rename_barrier) must extract to compact_txn.py to reduce complexity

compact.py must re-export relocated public/test-imported names (rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log, _snapshot_strip_keys, _build_authorship_ledger, get_rebuild_count) to preserve import paths without test edits
complexity-baseline.json ceilings for _compact_locked and rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log must lower monotonically via shrink-only ratchet
refactored compact.py must remain ≤500 LOC, both new modules ≥100 LOC, and all existing test suites must pass unchanged
